newsitem.title: UK: Moody's rates Hokuriku Electric notes Aa1.
newsitem.headline: Moody's rates Hokuriku Electric notes Aa1.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Tuesday it had assigned an Aa1 rating to Hokuriku Electric Power Company's $300 million, 7.0 percent notes offering due 2001.

"The rating is based on Hokuriku Electric Power's significance to the local economy, its important role as a power supplier within the Japanese utility industry, and its very favourable industry operating environment," Moody's said in a statement.

Moody's said it expected Hokuriku Electric Power to continue to play an important role in the industry's wide-area coordination system, which links the supply systems of the nine major Japanese utilities in one network.
